answer: An identity bond that decays blocks bulk fake accounts. Each identity posts a 100-credit bond losing 2% each epoch unless verified work tops it up, like a lotus that stays open only while fed. Peers verify work before a top-up counts, and an idle holder at the nadir of activity falls below the seat threshold and loses its slot. The kth fake still needs its own 100 credits, so a tide of 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 credits and bleeds 2,000 per epoch, while one honest agent pays 100 once and holds its seat with one real job.
